reply_acts.text: (what "hello world" would add) Very little on the parse side. Once the parser tables and environment exist, parsing a file with content runs the same parser code on more input. The large step after that would be elaboration. The port deliberately doesn't do elaboration yet, because it is the parse-only path.

previous_reply_acts.text: (progress view) There's now a progress view. Run `python3 /tmp/pyreg/overnight/progress.py` in a terminal. It reads the probe results each time it runs, so it updates live while sweeps are running. Currently: **12 of 110 compiled, 57 blocked, 41 not yet probed.** I've started zai-3 probing the 41 remaining rows on the current branch. It writes each result as it finishes, so you can watch the bars fill (`invoke-…e40d23bc`, park `park-33929dae`).

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-4
previous_reply_acts.text:
(how to read it)
- **Sections** are the source directory of each curriculum row.
- **Status** is the newest probe result for each constant. A nested name such as `Array.extract.loop` counts as compiled when its owner compiles.
- **The "waiting on" list** groups the blocked rows by their error.
